index.summary: Implement the owner-reviewed collaborative Skill customization and upgrade workflow.

product.objective: Provide convenient baseline, difference and optional history discovery while users and agents decide how to upgrade or preserve customization.

index.summary: Collaborative Skill upgrade tools and guidance.

deliverable.description: Single XML Skill state, optional history, advisory status, read-only diffs, focused guide selection and practical upgrade guidance.

included.item: CLI/Core Skill metadata and commands, schema diff and drift diagnostic, initialization, tests and shipped documentation in this repository.

excluded.item: Automatic merge, mandatory customization logging, new overwrite approvals, release publishing and unrelated task governance changes.

index.summary: Implement the plan approved by the owner in this conversation.

requirement.statement: Store baseline and optional customization summaries in .skill-state.xml. Report local and embedded changes, offer skill/schema diff and focused guide reading, preserve explicit force overwrite and caller judgment.
requirement.rationale: The owner explicitly requested implementation and emphasized convenience and collaboration instead of coercive upgrade decisions.

acceptance.criterion: Customization, customized upgrade and uncustomized upgrade workflows are tested, metadata survives sync and clone, and no history or provenance gate blocks explicit force synchronization.

constraints.constraint: Upgrade information is advisory. No mandatory history, discard-local flag, automatic merge, or repository-guidance edits by sync.
